criteria.dual_mode:
Pair each render with an html run and reinsert
elements where the html pass shows them.
criteria.normalize_soft:
Treat all in-paragraph newlines uniformly as soft wraps; never emit
.
criteria.reject_hard: Refuse inputs containing hard-break syntax rather than rendering them approximately (markdown::rejected_break).

break_policy.instructions: Choose break handling given render reports every paragraph line ending identically.

criteria.allow_all_native: No renderer-side restriction beyond Bun's own minting; autolinks enabled and the gate loosened for http/mailto/fragments.
criteria.allow_fragments: Minimum plus intra-document navigation: admit #fragment hrefs, enable heading self-links, extend the gate for fragments.
criteria.strict_https_local: Minimum viable web: https and /local hrefs; autolink expansion disabled; http, mailto:, and #fragment rejected (markdown::unsupported_url).

link_scope.instructions: Set the link allowlist for safe rendering.

criteria.drop_details: Preserve shape, abandon precision: aligned/offset/task-decorated content renders as plain lists and tables.
criteria.full_fidelity: Close the gap in html.ts (cell align from a fixed triple, ol start as an integer) and reproduce all reported values with synthesized checkbox inputs for tasks.
criteria.subset_reject: Treat align, non-unit start, and task markers as fatal unsupported constructs and reject the document with markdown::unsupported_construct.

table_list_fidelity.instructions: Pick the contract for list/table details the parser reports but the gate cannot yet hold.

state:
Runtime law first: runtime/platform/html.ts is the G-HTML gate for B1-12 Markdown on pinned Bun 1.4.2, and only element trees it accepts can flow into renderSafe. Its parseURL takes https links and local / paths and refuses http, mailto:, and fragment targets such as #hello; its tag set covers headings, paragraphs, quotes, lists, the full table family, del, br, hr, code, pre, links, images, and input, while u and s are absent; global attributes cover id, class, and title, yet neither align for cells nor start for ordered lists exists in the attribute table. Against those bars, pinned Bun.markdown.render probes establish what the safe renderer can faithfully rebuild: listItem callbacks with ordering, nesting depth, start offset, and task checked state; thead/tbody/tr/th/td callbacks with align metadata; heading level plus slug id (hello-world) when ids are on; fenced code language preserved verbatim feeding class language-js; strikethrough as ; NUL normalized to U+FFFD. The probes equally establish what must be contained: wikiLinks silently sheds targets in render mode (html mode shows ), so it stays disabled; raw HTML is contained with noHtmlBlocks/noHtmlSpans, which reduce markup to text, because html mode passes it through raw and tagFilter stops at <script; underline and latexMath are dead switches in this build; autolinks would mint http:// and mailto: hrefs the gate rejects; hard breaks are invisible to render (both break kinds arrive as newlines, only html mode writes
), so numbering like start="5" and task checkbox synthesis are the renderer's own job. Earlier rounds fixed budgets: standaloneBytes ceilings set by the adapter, no caller limit records.
